committee.sub: Morning brief · Sunday 8 November 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The $600 promo credit is now fully drawn (creditRemainingExGst $0) against $657.37 ex GST spent on 94 raw paid clicks since the landing page test started 6 Oct, while rank-based impression loss (76%) still dwarfs budget-based loss (16.4%), so the A$7 CPC cap is not the limiting factor here.

With the page frozen past click 25, engagement stays lopsided: ask_cta_click sits at 17 against quick_question_click at 3 and review_cta_click at 0, so the lighter ask-first action is doing all the work and nobody has tried to book the review yet.

Two unverified enquiries have come through (generate_lead eventsSinceStart 2, leads last7 2 versus 0 prior, formStartsLast7 2 matching) but none are confirmed qualified, so these still need grading against the business-plus-process-plus-named-system rule before counting as demand.

Organic Search sessions fell to 5 from 11 last week, with google/organic down to 3 from 11, AI Assistant visits sat at 0 for both this week and last, and Search Console only runs through 5 Nov, two days behind yesterday, so there is no fresh unpaid or AEO signal to point to.

actions.text: Credit remaining has hit $0 of the $600 test budget, so the pause rule is now live: hold paid search unless cost per qualified enquiry is $480 or under and at least one qualified prospect has booked a review. Check the test log before any further spend.
Raw paid clicks have reached 94, past the 75-click checkpoint. Chris needs to check the test log now: if relevant clicks are 75 or more with zero qualified enquiries, the red flag fires.
Two generate_lead events are logged since the test started. Check the Formspree and Cal.com confirmation emails for source and grade each one against the qualified rule in the test log.
Logo and image assets for the serving ad groups (Agency, Job Intake) remain outstanding.
RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin saved per week and 99.6% success. These need updating to match current site stats.
